---
aliases:
  - Delayed Linked Abilities
---
**Delayed Linked Abilities** are the [[Delayed Ability]] version of [[Linked Ability|Linked Abilities]] that are generated by another [[Ability]] and reference that [[Ability]] or [[Game Object]] it affects instead of a window of time.

If that [[Ability]] affects a [[Game Object]], the **Delayed Linked Ability**’s window will be as long as that [[Game Object]] is in an appropriate zone.

If the **Delayed Linked Ability** references the source of the [[Ability|ability]], its window will be as long as the source is in an appropriate zone.

The appropriate zones for these **Delayed Linked Abilities** will be determined implicitly by the [[Linked Ability]] that generated them. If the [[Linked Ability]] causes the affected [[Game Object|Game Objects]] to change zone to a [[Non-Board Zone]], the appropriate zone for the **Delayed Linked Ability** will be the zone the [[Game Object]] is moved to. Otherwise, the appropriate zone is whatever zone the [[Linked Ability]] triggered or was played from, or whatever zone the affected [[Game Object]] is located in when it is affected.
